products.title: A1 Mini 3D printer + BMCU 370C
products.desc:
Bambu labs A1 mini 3D printer is great condition. Comes with the open source AMS, the BMCU 370C. 

This printer works perfectly/reliably without issues; it has been kept very clean and well lubricated. I'm the first owner and it has served me well. It has ~480 hours as of writing this but this may increase. Selling since I now require a larger print bed.

It also comes with the BMCU 370C fully assembled and working for 4-color prints. This works basically the same as an AMS lite but much more compact; you should be aware the firmware should be on <1.05.00 for it to work. I found the newer firmware slows down the printer anyways so I prefer the old one. 

Comes with the following:
- A1 mini
- BMCU 370C
- 625 bearing spool holders (different from pic)
- BIQU Cryogrip frostbite plate (prints PLA/PETG at low temps)
- Stock textured pei plate
- Bed scraper
- 0.2/04/0.6/0.8mm hardened steel nozzle replacement kit (only .8mm used, rest are new)

products.title: Makerbot Motherboard & Extruder Daughterboard for Replicator+ 3D Printer
products.desc:
Motherboard and carriage/toolhead daughterboard combo for the Makerbot Replicator+ (5th gen) 3D printer. This is the 2nd revision, Rev G (2015) and Rev I (2016) as seen in the photos. Motherboard currently has the factory default 2.6.3 firmware installed. Daughterboard supports both Makerbot Smart Extruder+ and Tough Smart Extruder+.

These were pulled out of a working unit and function perfectly. There is no cosmetic or physical damage. Included is the motherboard (+ backplate), extruder daughterboard and the ribbon cable.

products.title: Makerbot Hoboken LCD control board for Makerbot Replicator+ 3D Printer
products.desc:
Makerbot Hoboken TFT LCD control board and rotary encoder for Makerbot Replicator+ (5th generation) 3D Printer. This is the 2nd revision (Rev. I 2015) model.

The board was pulled out of a working unit and works perfectly with no issues. Everything is in like new condition with no damage. Included is the board, the PoE hdmi cable (to connect to mainboard) and the screen protector cover.

products.title: Apple iPhone 4s - 16 GB - Black (iOS 7) (LOT OF 2)
